correctness.rationale: For an unfilled graph the lower link is a cone exactly at one lower neighbor. The acyclic orientations of the ten edges are precisely those induced by vertex orders, so enumerating their induced matching sets and all subsets reconstructs the full complex. Independent exact replay enumerated 240 acyclic orientations, got face vector (20,55,20), validated the twenty successive unique-proper-coface pairs from the frozen JSON as data, and verified connectedness of the residual (20,35) graph. Its integral cycle rank is 16. Signed simplicial traces were (20,55,20), (0,0,0), and (2,-3,0) for identity, nonidentity rotations, and reflections, respectively. Lefschetz with connected H0 gives H1 traces (16,1,-4), the rational character of 4 epsilon plus 3 V, with zero invariants. This proves an ordinary collapse onto a graph and a rational representation statement, not an equivariant collapse or an integral module decomposition.
